name: inkdrop-git-sync
description: Bidirectional synchronization between Inkdrop notes and a Git repository

scripts.check: node --check lib/inkdrop-git-sync.js && node --check lib/sync-engine.js && node --check lib/git-service.js

enabled.title: Enable scheduled synchronization
enabled.description: Enable only after reviewing the migration preview and using a dedicated sync folder.

mode.title: Operating mode
mode.description: Existing installations stay in export mode until bidirectional sync is explicitly selected.

token.title: GitHub Token
token.description: GitHub token used through Git credential prompting; it is never stored in the remote URL.

repository.title: GitHub repository
repository.description: Private knowledge repository in owner/repository format.

syncFolder.title: Dedicated sync folder
syncFolder.description: Use a new dedicated folder. Managed notes are stored under notes/.

includedBooks.title: Included notebooks
includedBooks.description: Optional comma-separated notebook IDs. Empty includes all notebooks.
